title: Grateful Dead Live at Chateau d'HerouvilIe on 1971-06-21

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard capture (mono intro, stereo thereafter) of the mysterious 1971 French private party, highlighted by a smoking Hard to Handle, powerful Black Peter and tight early‑71 performances.
ai_review.review: The recording offers decent board quality – the first six tracks are mono with an AM‑tape patch, but from track 7 onward the stereo mix is clear and well‑balanced. Musically the show shines: fans rave about a fiery Hard to Handle, one of the best Black Peter’s ever heard, and tight versions of China > Rider, Playing in the Band and Johnny B. Goode, all delivered with high energy by the five‑member 1971 lineup.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars for the performance and note only minor recording flaws; the show is described as hot, fun and musically strong, outweighing the patch/mono issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First six tracks mono with an AM‑tape patch (not great), but tracks 7‑18 are clean stereo soundboard with a nice mix; occasional mediocre sections noted, overall listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight early‑71 set with concise, energetic renditions that build into a fiery middle; transitions flow well and the band stays tight throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his presence on video and guitar work; described as great and dream‑like.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen handles electric piano (no organ) with tasty licks; keyboards noted positively.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann highlighted as the real star of the night, delivering an outstanding drum performance.
